title: Hunts FH-044S: Edition and import screens, and the rule for runs in flight at a release

source.ref: Split from FH-044 (2026-11-16): the edition pins, crosswalk, imports and old grant reads shipped dark; the screens and one owner decision move here.

detail: Owed after FH-044 (ADR-1972). (1) Owner decision: when a new edition is released, a run in flight on the old one becomes a record and takes no new credit (hunt_claim_apply answers version_superseded, lib/hunts/claim-store.ts reads the current version). Decide whether such a run may finish on its old edition for a grace window. If yes, Game systems changes the claim command and claim-store to accept a superseded edition inside its window; that edit was held back because parallel rows were changing the same function. (2) Web: the editor's publish step for a Trail that already has a published edition still calls publishTrailAction, which carries no printed code and leaves the old edition marked published; point it at releaseEditionAction and show the crosswalk, the retired codes and the count of runs left behind before the tap. (3) Web: the import doors (a Regulars hunt from its host Space's hunts screen, a QR campaign from /admin/qr) calling the actions in app/(main)/hunts/edition-actions.ts and showing the notices. (4) Web: show a player their run record on an earlier edition (loadRunRecord) and their old rewards (readOldGrants) on the Trail page. (5) Database owner: apply migration 20270346082000_hunt_teams_editions.sql through the serialized gate and confirm supabase/tests/hunt_editions.test.sql passes in db-tests. (6) Operator: walk one pilot Trail through a release with real printed codes and confirm each old code opens the right stop. Done when: a second edition released from the editor carries its printed codes, and the owner's rule for runs in flight is the one the claim command enforces. Requires: FH-044, FH-013. Owner role: Web, with Game systems. DONE 2026-11-16: owner chose '7-day grace to finish' (ADR-1976). hunt_claim_apply gains the window in migration 20270346085000_hunt_edition_grace.sql (written, not applied; pgTAP supabase/tests/hunt_edition_grace.test.sql) and lib/hunts/claim-store.ts credits a run still finishing on its edition (lib/hunts/editions.ts EDITION_GRACE_DAYS). The editor's publish step for a Trail with a published edition calls releaseEditionAction through app/(main)/hunts/edit/[id]/release-edition.tsx after showing the crosswalk, retired codes and runs left behind (previewRelease). The import doors sit on the host Space's Hunts section and /admin/qr campaigns (components/hunts/import-trail-door.tsx). The player page shows the earlier-edition run (loadRunRecord via loadEarlierRun) and old rewards (readOldGrants). Items (5) applying the migrations and (6) the operator's printed-code walk moved to FH-044T.
